Fill the watering globe and insert it properly
Water thoroughly until it drains when the top 1–2 inches are dry
Move the plant to bright indirect light
Trim dead, crispy leaves and the leggiest stems
Pinch stem tips to encourage fuller growth
Root the trimmings in a glass of water
Check that the pot has drainage holes
